semantic.justification: TaskAPQYXE adds a browser metadata bridge over existing actual configured/loaded default-font family selection and actual shared Font. Pinned native GetDefaultFont role switch supplies stored family,pitch,symbol encoding and12height;platform text encoding is explicit,style retains genuine Font default,and missing loaded families remain absent. Writer device API is unchanged. This is only the represented metadata of the configured/matched branch,not a fake OutputDevice,physical fallback,MaybeAskConfig,full Font weight/language or Calc document-pool constructor. TaskWP2DC4 connects the actual shared Writer FontSizeSelect through Calc FontHeight slot10015 and ScFormatShell to real document/sheet/column/default-column ScAttrArray runs, ScPatternAttr and shared itemsets. Original height200twips100percent defaults and three-script font-size application are retained. Real ScUndoSelectionAttr stores an attribute-only ScDocument plus marks and redo delta; content remains in original cell stores. Automatic ODF cell styles preserve script font heights and styled empty row/column spans through actual package/autosave/open. ScDocumentPool exports only original contiguous character prefix100..124; no defaults are invented for unsupported cell/page items. Default fonts use source script-language fallbacks, shipped configuration and original no-device OnlyOne logical-family branch without claiming installed faces. Full native format/dialog/script-aware painting,automatic row height,named cell styles,family application and remaining cell/page defaults remain unverified. Writer visible-content/two-word naming,primary storage and no-recovery deviations remain. This leaf does not certify complete Calc UI parity.
